metadata.title: Which Immersions into Euclidean Space are Boundary Immersions?
metadata.abstract: Here we study the problem of whether a given codimension one immersion $f$ of a closed and connected manifold into Euclidean space can be extended to an equidimensional immersion $F$ of some compact manifold $M$ whose restriction to the boundary parameterizes the image $S$ of $f$. Such an extension $F$ exists if and only if (i) simple conditions on orientations and wrapping numbers are satisfied and (ii) a distinguished finite subset of the first cohomology of $S$ with coefficients in a certain sheaf of finite groups contains the preferred point.
metadata.comment: 27 pages, 16 figures. This paper here is a condensed portion of the author's PhD thesis in progress. A.I. tools were used only to help create figures and to survey for existing literature. Comments are encouraged!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究闭连通流形的余维一欧氏浸入何时能延拓为某紧流形的等维浸入边界，给出取向、绕数和一个有限群层系数 H¹ 中特定有限子集的充要判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 把几何延拓问题编码为有限障碍的判定。
analysis.limitations: 这是浸入延拓，不能与嵌入填充混淆；有限集合与首选点的具体构造需读正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
